title: Antique Atlas Redesign, Dark Mode, Map Quizzes & Question Engine Fixes
body:
- Introduced a full antique cartographic redesign across all interactive maps, mode cards, and navigation, paired with a new Night Atlas dark mode toggle in the header.
- Added dedicated Powiat and US State Map Quizzes with animated feedback and target-change indicators, alongside Map Border Hop and Flag Shades.
- Fixed local question evaluation for coastal and city-county boolean checks, English/Polish voivodeship seat aliases (Warsaw/Warszawa), voivodeship name-vs-seat comparisons, Congress Poland historical partition queries, and inverted county word order.
- Updated Terms of Service, FAQ, About, How It Works, and crawler metadata across all current game modes.
